deliverables: Intersect budget administration, audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with project-specific management described for Mithril.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund continued Mithril Protocol development through Intersect on behalf of the vendor.

claims.claim: Mithril uses stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way so nodes and applications can verify state rapidly without relying on the entire chain.
The proposal states that full node synchronization is slow and light clients rely on centralized trust, creating a pressing infrastructure challenge for Cardano.

The proposal says Mithril strengthens cross-chain interoperability, lowers onboarding friction, and enables tooling for exchanges, wallets, monitoring, bridges, light wallets, full wallets, and light clients.
The requested budget is 3,699,440 ADA for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development plus a 110,983 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee, totaling 3,810,423 ADA.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain treasury withdrawal submission under the approved framework.
The requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

Audit and oversight costs are included in the overhead, with independent oversight provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties using reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
Teragone has not previously received direct Cardano treasury or community governance funding, but has worked on Mithril for several years through IOG-funded collaboration.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisig-like authorization thresholds, and an Oversight Committee consisting of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl.
A public dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is provided for community audit and tracking of the withdrawn ADA and related TRSC or PSSC metrics.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ADA for Mithril Protocol continuous development and Intersect administration, presents strategic infrastructure benefits, cites Intersect budget-process approval and NCL compliance, and describes smart-contract-based fund custody and oversight, but it does not include a complete proposal summary, detailed budget analysis, feasibility assessment, risk analysis, alternatives analysis, or failure-mode analysis.
